displayTitle: These Are the Droids You're Looking for
synopsis: Star Wars: These Are the Droids You're Looking For is a search and find book including scenes from throughout the Skywalker saga. Can you find these droids before the Stormtroopers do? Search for R2-D2, C-3PO, BB-8, and more of your favorite Star Wars droids in this interactive search-and-find with locations from across the Skywalker Saga. The Stormtroopers are looking for droids, and it is your mission is to find R2-D2, C-3PO, BB-8, and other Star Wars droids and characters as they journey throughout the galaxy in this interactive search-and-find. With scenes from Naboo, Hoth, Exegol, and other locations from across the Skywalker Saga, this book is full of non-stop fun for every Star Wars fan.
title: These Are the Droids You're Looking for
